_comment: Microphone array definition for the Amazon Echo Dot 2nd gen (biscuit).
Everything here is measured on hardware, not inferred. How each value
was measured follows.
Geometry: steel rule on PCB 30-002149 REV 01. Three independent readings
agreed (centre-to-outer 36.5, opposite pair 72.0 centre-to-centre, and
75.0 edge-to-edge less a 3 mm package). Adjacent outer pair also 36 mm,
which equals the radius and is the defining property of a regular hexagon.
Channel map: occlusion test with a continuous 1 kHz tone, measured in the
tone bin (Goertzel) to reject the broadband noise floor. Each mic was
covered and compared against an uncovered capture taken seconds earlier.
MK1-MK3 showed -17 to -19 dB drops with 21-25 dB margins; MK4-MK7 were
confirmed the same way after switching to paired baselines.
Frame: +x is the white silkscreen arrow, angles counterclockwise, viewed
from the COMPONENT SIDE of the board. Viewed from the other face the
handedness mirrors and every steering angle with it.
Note no microphone sits on the arrow axis - it bisects the MK4/MK5 edge.

_note: Capture is dead after boot until UCM fires _enadev Mic - alsactl
restores control values but never re-fires DAPM, so the mixer looks
correct while the path is unpowered. It also needs a playback stream
running: the dough FPGA aggregates the TDM mics onto SPI and gates
capture on its own DAC reference. Failure mode is a bare EIO naming
enable: alsaucm -c mt8163-biscuit set _verb HiFi set _enadev Mic

reference_channel.purpose: speaker/DAC loopback for acoustic echo cancellation
evidence: exactly zero for all acoustic input, including taps
full level whenever the speaker plays
0.0 dB drift between captures while every acoustic channel drifts 0.5-3 dB
consistent with the 4th TLV320ADC3101 (i2c 0x1b) having one mic (MK7)
and its second input wired to the speaker feedback

_comment: Per-unit factory gains live in each Echo's idme (miccal.N, Q14, 16384 = unity).
The shipped weights are computed at unity; the device applies its own
calibration at runtime. The values below are therefore all unity, not any
one unit's calibration.

_note: Delays are fractional - integer sample shifts will not steer correctly.
The array aliases above ~4.76 kHz; that is the price of the large
aperture (mics at 92% of board radius), which buys good low-frequency
directivity in exchange. Fine for speech and wake word.
Steering: tau_i = -(x_i*cos(phi) + y_i*sin(phi)) / c, times 16000 for
